verdict.rationale: Feitian's docs describe an HOTP function that emulates an HID keyboard to type the code automatically. OTP functions are configurable through SK Manager and an OTP Tool that switches protocols, and the Android FEITIAN Authenticator app exposes OTP functions. Together these cover the core of the story: legacy OTP for services without WebAuthn. missing for 10: explicit documentation of TOTP slots, any challenge-response mode, clarity on which key models ship OTP, independent or hands-on corroboration.
